notes.title: Level Editor Beta Update - Build 2025_05_08
notes.notes:
[h3]A new update is available for the [editor_testing] beta branch![/h3]

For this update I've focus on improving the workshop publishing features and Quality-of-life features and improvements for the editor. Most of the essential functionality is there now and it's possible to build, publish and play user-made levels already!


[b]Here's the full list of changes for this update:[/b]

[u]New content / features:[/u]
- smoke and fire vfx assets added
- toggle visibility of all objects in an outliner category
- toggle locked state of all objects in an outliner category
- added option to update existing workshop item
- button added for opening published level in workshop

[u]Improvements:[/u]
- publish window checklist added
- publish window level preview added
- inspector now supports multi-editing position/rotation/scale per axis
- xyz for position, rotation and scale now draggable in the inspector
- enclosed box selection now works better with scaled objects and has padding

[u]Fixes:[/u]
- bug fix: barge buttons broken in game
- bug fix: gate position ignored in custom levels
- bug fix: level framing now consistent between editor and game
- bug fix: medal time inputs offset with scrolling


Huge thanks to everyone building levels and posting feedback! It makes all the difference :)

For anyone who wants to try out the editor and workshop, there's a full guide here on how to run the editor beta: https://steamcommunity.com/games/1358790/announcements/detail/529843687122797519


Next up I will be focusing on getting the tool for painting the ground working and getting the remaining assets into the editor. I will also be fixing bugs and continue the work on making the editor a nice tool to spend time in!


/ Pontus

notes.title: Level Editor Beta Branch live!
notes.notes:
I've just uploaded a version of the game that has the new level editor! It's still in beta version, so expect a few bugs here and there. I'm still working on it but could really use some feedback. Once the editor is at a stage where it feels completed, it will be included in the main branch of the game, but for now it's useful to be able to do regular updates to the beta branch :)


[h2]Here's how you get started with the Level Editor:[/h2]


[u][h3]How to launch the Level Editor Beta Branch:[/h3][/u]
- Right-click on Tipston Salvage in your Steam Library and click on "Properties..."
- In the Properties window, go to Betas
- In the top right corner of the Betas window, there's a drop-down that says "None". Change this to "editor_testing"
- Launch the game!



[u][h3]How to access the Level Editor in-game:[/h3][/u]
- When running the beta version of Tipston Salvage, go into the Mission Center (level select room)
- Click the new button that says "CUSTOM LEVELS"
- In the Custom Levels window, click the "OPEN LEVEL EDITOR" in the lower left corner to launch the level editor!
- The Custom Levels window can currently only be interacted with using the Mouse!



[u][h3]How to access the Steam Workshop during Beta:[/h3][/u]
- The Workshop is currently hidden for the main game while the level editor is in beta.
- To get access to the hidden workshop you need to join the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/tipston_lb]Tipston Salvage Level Builders[/url] community on Steam. Follow the link and request access there and I'll add you to the group.
- Once I've approved your request, you'll be able to see the workshop on the Tipston Salvage Steam Community Hub.
- The workshop can also be opened from within the game by clicking the "GET LEVELS" button in the Custom Levels window
- You can now upload and download custom levels to the Workshop




Please note that since the level editor is still being worked on, things can and most likely will break. I will do my best to keep old level files compatible with each update of the editor, but I can make mistakes 🙃

If you have any questions or feature requests, the easiest way to get in touch is on the official [url=https://discord.gg/myvzywn]Discord Server[/url]. Posting here on Steam or in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/tipston_lb]Tipston Salvage Level Builders[/url] community works well too!

Let's make some levels!


/ Pontus

notes.title: Version 1.1 is here!
notes.notes:
Hi there lovely players, Pontus here. I've just released the first major update for Tipston - Version 1.1!

My main focus for this update has been to expand and improve upon the solo campaign, as well as other smaller improvements and fixes. Initially the game was supposed to be co-op only, but late in development I decided to include some content that could be played by one person - and good thing I did! Turns out a lot of players have enjoyed the solo campaign, so I made 6 more solo levels to make it a better experience :)


[h2]Here's the full list of updates:[/h2]


[h3]🗺️ NEW SOLO LEVELS[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626761/14660808a4f21de0fc3b239c017bbf04b37dcc0f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Timber Transfer (Beginner)
[*] Spotty Placements (Beginner)
[*] Turbine Trouble (Easy)
[*] Carry On (Hard)
[*] The Clog (Hard)
[*] Hasty Rummage (Extreme)
[/list]


[h3]🎨 NEW AND IMPROVED PLAYER COLORS[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626761/93280aeb54949e6e70918cd0a27ffdb27b4c81d5.png[/img]
[list]
[*] 6 new paint blocks added to the garage
[*] Some colors have been tweaked to be more distinct and look nicer
[/list]


[h3]✨ IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] German localization has been improved - Huge thanks to "west" on the official Discord server!
[*] Keyboard controls for selected layout now shown in the player menu
[*] Art pass on levels "Excess Express" (1P), "Across n' Around" (1P) and "Flip Flop Junk Drop" (1P)
[/list]


[h3]🥇 BALANCING[/h3]
[list]
[*] Unlocking level packs in the solo campaign is now easier
[*] Some gold medals are now easier to achieve in the solo campaign
[*] The times for the higher medals are now harder for the later levels in the 2P campaign
[/list]
[i]I apologize in advance for any medals gained or lost due to my balancing changes - I hope the time limits are more consistent now - I don't want to change them again 🫠

Finding appropriate time limits for all medals on all levels across all player counts is no simple task. It's taken a lot of playing the game, listening to feedback and comparing records. My goal has been to find a balance between giving new and inexperienced players a fun challenge, while more experienced players can aim for the higher medals with a steady increase in difficulty.[/i]


[h3]🛠️ GENERAL FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Some of the prompt screens having missing localization or wrong information
[*] UI buttons in pause menu not centered in all aspect ratios
[*] Level difficulty not matching pack difficulty in solo campaign
[*] Player color resets to default color when returning to home level after rejoining player or resetting settings
[/list]

[h3]🛠️ LEVEL SPECIFIC FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Junk gets stuck on conveyors easily on levels "Auto Loader" (2P) and "This Side That Side" (2P)
[*] Dumping amount text in Planning Phase covered by player spawners on level "Storeroom Squeeze" (3/4P)
[*] Track marks leave stretched artifacts outside play area on level "Downstream" (1P)
[*] Dust effect shows when driving on wooden deck and barge on level "Floating Bridge" (2P)
[/list]



[h2]What else is going on?[/h2]


[h3]❄️ STEAM WINTER SALE[/h3]

Tipston Salvage will be available at a [b]25% discount[/b] during the Steam Winter Sale, which takes place on Steam between the 19th of December to 2nd of January! A great time to get a new co-op game for the holiday season! 👀



[h2]And lastly, a huge thank you to everyone for playing![/h2]

It has been incredible to see the reception and reading all the reviews and comments! I hope you'll enjoy this update! If you have any feedback or questions, don't hesitate to write. I do my best to respond to all the posts I can find, but the fastest way to get in touch is on the official [url=https://discord.gg/myvzywn]Discord Server[/url]!

Thank you all so much for the support! ❤️


Have a nice winter holiday!


/ Pontus

notes.title: Updated Demo!
notes.notes:
Hi there lovely Tipston players!

I've just uploaded a new version of the demo that comes with a couple of fixes and a new highly requested feature - [b]Screen based controls[/b]!

Instead of controlling your truck like a vehicle, you can now simply point in the direction you want to go with the joystick and the truck will move in that direction! You can access the new gamepad template under [i]Player Settings -> Gamepad Template[/i].

They might still need some tweaks so please let me know if they feel right :)




Here's the full changelog for the latest demo build:


[u]Tipston Salvage Demo v1.1:[/u]

- New screen based gamepad controls template
- Fixed a bug where the screen would get stuck after finishing a level
- Fixed a bug where the 4th player's truck don't reveal the green grid for correct placements
- Gamepad D-pad arrows can now be used for steering and controlling cursors
- New art for "Job completed" icon at end of intro levels that looks less like a clickable button



I also want to say thank you to everyone who've played the demo and to all of you who've given me feedback, either here on Steam, on Discord or through my feedback form! I read it all and do take your feedback into consideration. Thank you!

I intend to keep the demo available on Steam for now so everyone has a chance to try it!



/ Pontus
